title: Official blog sanitization notes stage 22
summary: This iteration adds aggregate-only sanitization diagnostics to the official-blog AI review handoff. Operators can now see whether preview-safe fields were redacted or truncated without exposing original values, private paths, field paths, or full-body text.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "official blog AI review handoff reports aggregate sanitization diagnostics|official blog review-handoff CLI reports aggregate sanitization diagnostics" tests/official-blog-knowledge.test.js tests/unit.test.js

node --test --test-name-pattern "official blog AI review handoff|official blog review-handoff|official blog workflow runbook is executable and safety-backed" tests/official-blog-knowledge.test.js tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Sanitizer visibility should be aggregate-only when the sanitized content may be private.
lessons.evidence: Stage 22 tests assert that handoff diagnostics include only numeric counts and a generic warning, while private markers, redacted values, field paths, and long tail markers stay out of the diagnostics object.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future handoff diagnostics as counters or boolean summaries unless there is a specific reviewed need for more detail.

lessons.lesson: Clean handoffs should stay quiet so operators only investigate actual sanitizer activity.
lessons.evidence: The clean Stage 18 replay handoff is expected to report zero sanitization counts and no sanitization warning while preserving the two include items and one manual-review item.
lessons.recommended_action: Avoid warning text for zero-count diagnostics in future internal workflow artifacts.

suggestions.issue: Sanitization counts show that a handoff was cleaned but do not identify which upstream feed produced the pollution.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 22 intentionally avoids field paths and raw values to prevent diagnostics from becoming a leakage surface.
suggestions.suggestion: If operator debugging needs more detail later, consider source-level aggregate buckets such as candidate count by company, without field paths or raw values.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Operators could isolate noisy feed exports while preserving the internal handoff privacy boundary.
suggestions.promotion_path: Future project iteration with tests proving any source-level diagnostics remain aggregate-only.
validation_evidence: official blog AI review handoff reports aggregate sanitization diagnostics
official blog review-handoff CLI reports aggregate sanitization diagnostics

followups.action: Consider source-level aggregate sanitizer counters if operator debugging later needs them.
